posts.title: Introducing rssdirectory.org
posts.description: Rssdirectory.org publishes Downread's library of feeds and offers it as a category-based directory. The site works with any feed reader and supports one-click following in several popular readers. You can even customize the Follow button with your own URLs to add unsupported readers. posts.title: Feed HTML - an HTML subset for RSS readers
posts.description:
I have set up a second RFC: Feed HTML defines an HTML set for RSS readers and similar applications. This addresses a long-standing issue with RSS: it allows HTML, but no one defines which HTML features you can use. Many simple RSS readers support some semantic features like ,

posts.title: Podcast Radar
posts.description: Just a few days ago I stumbled upon the <podcast:location> element in the Podcasting 2.0 spec, and wondered whether anybody uses this. Today, I found radar.rss.io on Hacker News, which is the first time I've seen the location element actually being used.
